compiled_state.description:
# Comment sync (append-only) with persistent Jira-comment-ID map

## Context / Problem
Comment sync identifies comments by **body equality** (normalized-text key in
`_diff_comments`), so same-text comments collide and an edited body looks new. Semantics are **append-only**: mirror comment *creation* both ways, never edits or
deletes. This story also **owns the DC comment-diff dedup-key migration `3388` deferred
here**: `3388` moved `WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound` to the rendering form for
descriptions but left the comment-diff path on the identity normalizer (a32a `_resolve_codec`
seam, default `_IdentityCodec`). Flipping that path to the real codec, and keeping
comment-diff convergent when it renders rich, is this story's job.

## Approach
**1. Identity = local comment key + returned Jira ID, not body.** Local key = the COMMENT event's **HLC `timestamp`** (unique, monotonic; already on the
compiled entry at `reducer/_processors.py:349`). Persist a
**`local_comment_key (HLC) → Jira comment ID`** map in binding state: outbound, an unmapped
key is created in Jira and its returned ID recorded; inbound, mirror Jira comments whose IDs
are not map values (entries carry `jira_comment_id`, bug 85a1). **Append-only**: no rebar
edit/delete pushed to Jira,
no Jira edit/delete applied to rebar; a mapped key/ID is never re-synced. The map is
change-gated, one fixed-shape entry per comment.

**1a. Capture the returned ID at both enactment sites**, discarded today. It rides only on
`SupportsComments.add_comment`'s returned `{"id": …}` dict (protocol `_backend.py:540`; Cloud
`backend.py:275`, DC `jira_datacenter/backend.py:462` delegate to the transport; Cloud
transport `acli_cli_ops.add_comment` returns `json.loads(result.stdout)` at `:515`). So (i) the local key rides ON the mutation entry as
`"local_comment_key": <HLC>`; (ii) `binding_store` reaches both loops: `create_one` has it,
and a new optional `binding_store` param on `update_one` → `_update_one_dispatch_comments`
is fed by `handle_update`/`_apply_outbound_update` (the latter via `_apply_typed`'s var-kw). Failures stay non-fatal (`comment_errors` unchanged).
**Crash-durability**: `record_comment_id` `save()`s immediately on the `add_comment` return
(write-ahead).

**1b. Two identity stores, one authoritative per DIRECTION, never crossed.** `jira_comment_id`
(bug 85a1) is authoritative for INBOUND-origin comments, the map for OUTBOUND-origin. **Outbound**: skip when EITHER the HLC key is mapped OR the comment carries
a `jira_comment_id`; the normalized-body test is DEMOTED, not removed, to a secondary skip against a lost map write. ID identity is the PRIMARY outbound
guard; the `RECONCILER_MARKER` exclusion stands. **Inbound**: `_diff_comments_inbound`
(`inbound_differ.py:280`) is UNCHANGED, never receives the map; its loop-breakers stand
(`RECONCILER_MARKER` bodies, ids matching a local `jira_comment_id`).

**2. Render bodies through the codec; migrate the dedup key.** Outbound bodies render
through the `RichTextCodec.to_wire` seam descriptions use (`AdfCodec.to_wire` Cloud,
`WikiTextCodec.to_wire` DC after `3388`). The Cloud comment path lacks an encode step:
`acli_cli_ops.add_comment` (`:492`) sends `--body <str>` (`:510-511`) unencoded.

**`--body` accepts ADF, and fit BEFORE encode (Cloud, load-bearing).**
`acli jira workitem comment create --help` documents `-b, --body string   Comment body in
plain text or Atlassian Document Format (ADF)` (probed read-only on installed acli, exit 0,
no Jira mutation), so `--body json.dumps(to_wire(body))` is supported like `--description`. Today `add_comment` runs the plaintext guard
`_sanitize_comment(body)` (`:502`); it must NOT run on serialized ADF (far longer than its text,
so truncation mismeasures length and can slice JSON mid-structure → a payload ACLI rejects).
Correct order, mirroring `AdfCodec.fit_outbound`: **fit the TEXT first**
(`AdfCodec(rich=...).fit_outbound(body)` → `fit_markdown_to_adf_limit`, bounding
`len(json.dumps(markdown_to_adf(...)))`), **then** `json.dumps(to_wire(fitted))`. The plaintext
truncation applies only on the plain branch (DC / rich `off`). DC `to_wire` returns `str`, so
DC `--body` stays plain wiki. Codec built as
`backend.py:52,64` do — `AdfCodec(rich="cloud" in cutover_clients())`, so `rich_text_cutover`
(`3388`, ships `off`) governs rendering. Then **flip the a32a
injection** (`_diff_comments`'s `_resolve_codec`) from `_IdentityCodec` to the real codec so
the local dedup key (via `normalize_outbound`) matches the landed wire.

Depends on `e59d`/`271c`/`3388` shipping first.

## Scope
Engine paths under `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/`:
- `binding_store.py` — the map + `record_comment_id(...)` write-ahead writer.
- `outbound_comments.py` — skip logic (1b); append `"local_comment_key"`; flip
  `_resolve_codec` to the real codec.
- `outbound_differ.py` — `compute_outbound_mutations` threads `binding_store` +
  `RichTextCodec` into `_diff_comments`.
- `dispatch_one.py` — `create_one` records the id; `update_one` gains optional `binding_store`.
- `dispatch_apply_phases.py` — `_update_one_dispatch_comments` records the id.
- `apply_handlers.py` / `apply_outbound.py` — thread `ctx.binding_store` through
  `handle_update` / `_apply_outbound_update` (from `_apply_typed`'s var-kw).
- `adapters/jira/acli_cli_ops.py` `add_comment` (`:492`) — Cloud ADF encode
  (fit-then-encode per Approach 2), guarded by `AdfCodec(rich="cloud" in cutover_clients())`.
- `reducer/_processors.py` — HLC key (`:349`); `jira_comment_id` (`:354-356`) unchanged.
- `inbound_differ._diff_comments_inbound` (`:280`) — **UNCHANGED, not in the edit set**.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Identity is the persistent COMMENT-HLC → Jira-comment-ID map, not the normalized-body
  key; verified by `test_comment_duplicate_bodies_distinct_ids`.
- [x] The returned `add_comment` `{"id": …}` is captured at both enactment sites
  (`create_one`; `update_one`→`_update_one_dispatch_comments` via `handle_update` /
  `_apply_outbound_update`) and persisted against the entry's `local_comment_key` via
  `record_comment_id` on Cloud (acli) and DC; verified by
  `test_comment_id_captured_and_persisted`.
- [x] Inbound-origin `jira_comment_id` (bug 85a1) and the outbound map are each
  authoritative for their own direction and never compete: the inbound differ is unchanged
  (ONLY `RECONCILER_MARKER` / `jira_comment_id`); the outbound differ skips when EITHER the
  key is mapped OR a `jira_comment_id` is present; verified by
  `test_comment_bidirectional_identity_no_double_sync`.
- [x] Comment sync is append-only both directions — new comments mirror once, edits/deletes skipped; verified by `test_comment_append_only`.
- [x] Outbound bodies render through `RichTextCodec.to_wire`: the Cloud ADF encode on the
  real create surface (`--body json.dumps(to_wire(fitted))`; `--body` confirmed by
  `acli jira workitem comment create --help` to accept ADF), fit-then-encode ordering (rich
  fit measures the wire BEFORE `json.dumps`; the plaintext `_sanitize_comment` guard never
  truncates serialized JSON), and the a32a `_resolve_codec` injection
  migrated to the real codec; verified by `test_comment_rendered_through_codec`,
  `test_comment_dedup_key_uses_real_codec`, `test_comment_adf_encode_fits_before_serialize`.
- [x] After migration, DC comment-diff converges with zero duplicate re-post; verified by
  `test_dc_comment_diff_converges_after_migration`.
- [x] A repeat reconcile pass creates no duplicate comments; verified by `test_comment_sync_idempotent`.
- [x] Crash-durability: `record_comment_id` `save()`s immediately on the successful
  `add_comment` return and the demoted body-equality test stays a secondary skip, so a lost
  map write does not re-post; verified by
  `test_comment_crash_between_add_and_map_save_no_duplicate`.
- [x] The comment-ID map is change-gated, no per-pass churn; verified by `test_comment_map_no_churn_on_no_new_comment_pass`.
